title: Prepositions
description: Use pictures to recognize and choose the position words under, above, near, far, and between.
learningFocus: Recognize frequently occurring prepositions in pictures and choose the word that correctly describes each object's position.
adultGuidance: Let your child describe each picture before reading the three choices together; if needed, ask where one object is compared with another without naming the answer. From top to bottom, the answers are under, above, near, far, and between.

seo.title: Prepositions Worksheet | Grade 1 Grammar
seo.description: A free printable Grade 1 worksheet for recognizing under, above, near, far, and between from clear picture clues.
